# Expected Nightly failures: `npm run verify:manifests` (tools/verify-manifest.ts).
#
# What this is: the exact failure lines verify:manifests currently
# produces on main, extracted with `grep -E '^  MISMATCH '` and sorted
# (LC_ALL=C). The `verify-manifests: FAILURES` summary line is
# deliberately not included: the per-code lines already encode the count.
# Inspected 2026-10-20 on origin/main: these lines contain only the
# relative manifest path, bot id, replay label, and re-simmed/claimed
# outcomes - no durations, absolute paths, or memory figures - so no
# further stripping is needed. Lines are kept verbatim, including the
# two leading spaces verify-manifest.ts prints. Comment lines starting
# with '#' are not extracted by the comparator.
#
# Identical lines below are NOT a typo: distinct featured replay codes
# can share the same bot, label, and outcome, and the MISMATCH line does
# not include the code itself. Multiplicity matters: do not de-duplicate.
#
# Green Nightly = baseline unchanged: the nightly comparator extracts the
# same lines from that night's log, sorts them the same way, and diffs
# them against the non-comment lines below. Exact match is green.
# Any difference is red: a new mismatch, a disappeared mismatch (a fix!),
# or a changed outcome all show as a diff.
#
# Intentional baseline changes update this file in the same PR as the
# change that causes them. Do not edit this file to silence a diff you
# have not explained in that PR. This file does not fix or re-pin
# anything; whether to re-baseline the underlying showcase is a separate
# decision.
